This is an Android-friendly preview of the conversation. It runs in your browser with a limited request parser and clearly labeled example prices. It does not send SMS or control a phone.

The included SMS backend connects a Twilio number to the same conversation engine, a persistent queue, and PhoneUse. Once configured, you can text it from Android’s normal Messages app.

Real SMS and live price collection are not activated. They need an SMS number, credentials, and a working phone signed into your apps.

Try changing the budget or arrival limit after a comparison. For a different basket or route, Fareplay asks before starting a new check.
